protocol.screening: 24 candidates per method/context, first two fixed source folds, seed11, reduced tree/round budget; exact duplicate screening fits reused
protocol.promotion: all reference candidates plus four best nonreference candidates; four source folds, seeds11/47, full capacity
protocol.selection: maximum macro source fold/seed AUROC or negative MSE/full-development-source variance; smallest candidate ID breaks ties; any failed fold excludes candidate; expanded selection includes reference candidates
protocol.failure_policy: retain errors; no solver relaxation, no target-driven retry, no baseline substitution for failed methods
protocol.budget_qualification: equal candidate counts and promotion rule, not equal CPU time; per-fit durations retained; no global-optimum claim
protocol.final_protocol: all source selection and final source model files frozen and committed before new target access
protocol.statistics: 24 primary tests in one Holm family: 15 tuned-minus-reference method/task gains and 9 tuned-minus-own-capacity-control gains; average scenarios equally then target domains/seeds, 10 independent MC data replicas; exact two-sided sign test with zeros omitted; marginal t95CI; real ACS descriptive only
protocol.hypothesis_scope: Conditional on one independently source-tuned configuration per development context; fresh final source draws, not per-replica retuning; new synthetic draws within known DGPs, not new mechanism families
protocol.real_scope: ACSIncome/PublicCoverage same survey family on five fresh states; Beijing/Appliances source HPO only because no fresh original real target remains
